property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, transfer returns true and does not revert if and only if all low-level calls to caddress.transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v) succeed; otherwise it reverts.
For any non-empty _tos, c.transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.
For any non-empty _tos, if c.transfer does not revert then it returns true (it never returns false on successful execution).
